senses.gloss: m. (denom. of next w.) cattle-driver, cattle-raiser, driver.
units: <cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 3:6">Deut. R. s. 3</cite> <he>והבהם עמו</he> and the driver (leader of the ass) was with him. *[<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 11:12:2">Y. Ned. XI, end, 42ᵈ</cite> <he>הבַּיאָם שלי פיתני</he> (= <cite ref="B00181"><he>בַהָם</he></cite>) my stable-man (a gentile) has seduced me.

<cite ref="Yoma 2a:5">Ib.</cite> <he>אין הביאם אוסר</he> (not <he>אסור</he>) (do you believe) the stable-man’s connection with thee has no restrictive consequences? [V. Noda Bihudah, 2ⁿᵈ ed., Eb. Haëz. Nr. 12.] <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 86">Gen. R. s. 86</cite> <cite ref="B00181"><he>בהמי</he></cite> (<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 145:4">Yalk. Gen. 145</cite> <he>אדם</he>, prob. <cite ref="B00181"><he>בהם</he></cite>).—Pl. <he>בַּהָמִים</he>, <he>בַּהָמִין</he>.
Y. Pes. I, 27ᵇ (in gen. servants).

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:4:7">Cant. R. to IV, 4</cite> (play on <he>ובבהמתך</he> <cite ref="Deuteronomy 7:14">Deut. VII, 14</cite>) there shall be none barren (of knowledge) among thee, <he>אפי׳ בב׳ שבכם</he> even among your cattle drivers; <cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 3:15">Deut. R. s. 3</cite>; a. e.; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 32:10">Gen. R. s. 32</cite> <he>בבהמות</he> (corr. acc.)—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maasrot 2:4:11">Y. Maasr. II, 50ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>התריגו לבהמין</he> (not <he>התריגי</he>) give the drivers (field laborers) oranges to eat; [<cite ref="Eruvin 53b:13">Erub. 53ᵇ</cite> <he>אתריגו לפחמין</he> in diff. connection].
